questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Generics and traits”?
options: Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
Obtain the installer from rust-lang.org and install native prerequisites only for the target you need.
A trait declares shared method behavior.
Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
questions.answer: A trait declares shared method behavior.
questions.explanation:
A trait declares shared method behavior.
Why: Generics parameterize reusable code. Traits describe shared behavior; bounds such as `T: Trait` require capabilities and often enable static dispatch through monomorphization.
